version.note: `mafft --version` inside the pinned image prints "v7.525 (2024/Mar/13)" to stderr, and /usr/local/bin/mafft hardcodes version="v7.525 (2024/Mar/13)". The conda-meta record for the package also says 7.525. All three agree, so this is read from the artefact rather than inferred from the image tag.

manifest.description: Multiple sequence alignment (MAFFT). Turns unaligned Sequence records into an Alignment, and can extend an existing Alignment with further sequences without realigning it from scratch.

align.description: Align sequences de novo with automatic strategy selection. --auto also picks the residue alphabet: probing showed 'tbfast-pair (nuc) model=DNA200' for nucleotide input and '(aa) model=BLOSUM62' for protein, so no alphabet flag is needed. --quiet is load-bearing: without it MAFFT writes ~62 lines of progress to stderr. Results go to stdout, not to a file.

sequences.description: Two or more unaligned sequences, nucleotide or protein.

alignment.description: Input order preserved (MAFFT's default; --reorder would change it). Residues are lowercased, which is MAFFT's documented default.

add.description: Add new sequences to an existing alignment, keeping the existing columns' homology and inserting gap columns where the new sequences need them. Plain --add is used rather than --add --keeplength: --keeplength would silently delete residues of the added sequences that fall in new insertions, which is data loss the caller cannot see.

additional.description: Unaligned sequences to place into that alignment.

alignment.description: The existing records first, in their original order, then the added ones.

guardrails: the repository changed during the run; the agent must work only in staging

license.note: Read verbatim from image metadata: /usr/local/conda-meta/mafft-7.525-h031d066_1.json gives "license": "BSD". That is all the image asserts — it names no clause count and ships no MAFFT licence text (/usr/local/share/licenses contains only gcc-libs and libstdc++ runtime exceptions). MAFFT upstream is commonly described as BSD-3-Clause, but I did not read the upstream LICENSE file (the probe sandbox has no network), so I recorded the weaker string the image actually states rather than upgrading it to BSD-3-Clause on recollection. A human should confirm the clause count against https://mafft.cbrc.jp before this is served to anyone.

command: mafft --version; echo '--- exit:'$?; ls /usr/local/libexec/mafft | head; echo '--- licenses:'; ls /usr/local/share/ 2>/dev/null | head -30; find / -iname '*LICENSE*' -path '*mafft*' 2>/dev/null | head

ls -R /usr/local/share/licenses 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo '=== conda meta ==='; ls /usr/local/conda-meta/ 2>/dev/null | grep -i mafft; python -c "import json,glob;f=glob.glob('/usr/local/conda-meta/mafft*.json')[0];d=json.load(open(f));print({k:d.get(k) for k in ['license','license_family','version','name','url']})" 2>/dev/null || grep -o '"license[^,]*' /usr/local/conda-meta/mafft*.json

ls -la; echo '=== no quiet ==='; mafft --auto seqs.fasta > out_noisy.fa 2> err_noisy.txt; echo exit=$?; echo stderr_lines=$(wc -l < err_noisy.txt); head -5 err_noisy.txt; echo '=== stdout of noisy run ==='; cat out_noisy.fa

mafft --auto /work/in/sequences.fasta > /work/out/noisy.fa 2> /work/out/noisy.err; echo exit=$?; echo '--- stderr line count:'; wc -l < /work/out/noisy.err; echo '--- first 12 stderr lines:'; head -12 /work/out/noisy.err; echo '--- stdout:'; cat /work/out/noisy.fa

cd /work/out; mafft --auto --quiet /work/in/sequences.fasta > a1.fa 2> q1.err; echo align_exit=$?; echo quiet_stderr_lines=$(wc -l < q1.err); cat q1.err; sleep 1; mafft --auto --quiet /work/in/sequences.fasta > a2.fa 2> q2.err; if cmp -s a1.fa a2.fa; then echo DETERMINISTIC; else echo NONDETERMINISTIC; diff a1.fa a2.fa | head; fi; echo '--- does output embed cmdline/timestamp?'; grep -n -iE 'mafft|version|date|/work|20[0-9][0-9]' a1.fa | head; echo '--- badinput ---'; printf 'not a fasta at all\njust text\n' > /work/out/bad.txt; mafft --auto --quiet /work/out/bad.txt > bad.out 2> bad.err; echo bad_exit=$?; echo bad_out_bytes=$(wc -c < bad.out); head -3 bad.err; echo '--- empty input ---'; : > empty.fa; mafft --auto --quiet empty.fa > e.out 2> e.err; echo empty_exit=$?; echo empty_bytes=$(wc -c < e.out); head -3 e.err

mafft --help 2>&1 | grep -iE 'quiet|case|add|reorder|thread|clustalout|inputorder|anysymbol' | head -40; echo '=== bad input WITHOUT quiet ==='; printf 'not a fasta at all\njust text\n' > /work/out/bad.txt; mafft --auto /work/out/bad.txt > /work/out/bad.out 2>/work/out/bad.err; echo exit=$?; tail -5 /work/out/bad.err; echo bytes=$(wc -c </work/out/bad.out)

cd /work/out; mafft --add /work/in/new.fasta --keeplength --quiet /work/in/aln.fasta > add1.fa 2> add1.err; echo add_exit=$?; echo add_err_lines=$(wc -l < add1.err); head -3 add1.err; echo '--- records:'; grep -c '^>' add1.fa; awk '/^>/{if(n)print n;n=0;next}{n+=length($0)}END{print n}' add1.fa; echo '--- last record:'; tail -5 add1.fa; sleep 1; mafft --add /work/in/new.fasta --keeplength --quiet /work/in/aln.fasta > add2.fa 2>/dev/null; cmp -s add1.fa add2.fa && echo DETERMINISTIC || echo NONDETERMINISTIC

cd /work/out; mafft --add /work/in/sequences.fasta --quiet /work/in/alignment.aln.fasta > p1.fa 2> p1.err; echo exit=$?; echo err_lines=$(wc -l < p1.err); echo records=$(grep -c '^>' p1.fa); awk '/^>/{if(n)print n;n=0;next}{n+=length($0)}END{print n}' p1.fa | sort -u; sleep 1; mafft --add /work/in/sequences.fasta --quiet /work/in/alignment.aln.fasta > p2.fa 2>/dev/null; cmp -s p1.fa p2.fa && echo DETERMINISTIC || echo NONDETERMINISTIC; echo '=== case options in mafft script ==='; grep -oE '\-\-[a-z]*case[a-z]*|preservecase|--originalseqonly' /usr/local/bin/mafft | sort -u; echo '=== all long opts mentioning case in help ==='; mafft --man 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'case' | head -5
cd /work/out; mafft --auto --quiet --preservecase /work/in/sequences.fasta > pc.fa 2> pc.err; echo exit=$?; echo err=$(wc -l < pc.err); head -3 pc.fa
